mapper.insert: INSERT INTO progress_submission (id, task_id, user_id, day, progress_before, progress_after, review_status, note, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{day}, #{progressBefore}, #{progressAfter}, #{reviewStatus}, #{note}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM progress_submission WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND review_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.task_id AS taskId, t.title AS title, s.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(s.day, CAST(s.created_at AS DATE)) AS day, s.review_status AS reviewStatus, t.kind AS kind FROM progress_submission s JOIN progress_task t ON t.id = s.task_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND COALESCE(s.day, CAST(s.created_at AS DATE)) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY day, title
